1395-2079-5078-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.

2438-2445-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2438-2445-5254.description:

When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder

262-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
262-4687-4929.description:

Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1400-3899-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-3899-4619.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2893-3875-6664-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

5657-6489-7735.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
5657-6489-7735.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
5657-6489-7735.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1453-3112-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
1453-3112-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Slurrk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5319-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
5319-5686-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-2097-3875-4231-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2267-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1879-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.

Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.

647-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

Animate Grim Monolith using Katsumasa.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the first two triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve all other Coercive Recruiter triggers, if applicable.
Repeat.
2534-5917.notes: You can use the extra Coercive Recruiter triggers to infinitely untap the mana-producing creature for extra mana.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Warden of the Eye, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

526-2232-3771.notablePrerequisites:

Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
